text:
Maya (AE): Heads up — Acme Health wants a short POC throughput window next Tue. They need up to 400 qps for ~2 hours and an ephemeral/scoped hosted API key + IP allowlist. Can we support?
Jordan (Sales Eng): Do we know their current limits on the account and expected token/sec shapes? Any compliance notes?
Maya (AE): They're on trial hosted account. Default is 60 qps. They'll do multi-stream chat sessions, roughly 25 tokens/resp avg. No extra compliance beyond IP allowlist. Window requested 2026-05-12 15:00-17:00 PST.
Sam (Platform Eng): We can do a temporary rate exception + scoped key. Need org id, the intended CIDR(s) to allow, and a canary ramp plan. Recommend gradual ramp: 0 -> 100 -> 200 -> 400 over ~15m steps to avoid sudden pressure.
Maya (AE): Org: org_acme_123. Customer contact: ben@acme.health. IPs: 34.120.10.0/24 and 44.55.66.77/32. They also want the key to be rotateable from their side.
Devin (SRE): OK. I can set the infra-side exception but need a ticket with those exact start/end epoch times and the request id. Also will add a latency-based fallback: if p95 > 150ms for >2m we throttle to 100 qps. Please ack.
Maya (AE): Acked. Start: 1915150000, End: 1915157200. Please create scoped key with role=poс_poc and expiry==end.
Jordan (Sales Eng): Quick billing note — usage above trial thresholds will follow the POC hosted rate. Maya, confirm customer is OK with a soft spend cap?
Maya (AE): Customer agreed to a hard cap of $500 for the window. They also want the ability to abort the test early.
Sam (Platform Eng): I will create the scoped key and attach the IP allowlist. Example curl to use the scoped key once created:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <SCOOPED_KEY_HERE>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-lite-1\",\"prompt\":\"hello\",\"max_tokens\":128}'
```
Sam (Platform Eng): Also adding rate limits header guidance, client should respect 429 backoff and do exponential backoff with jitter.
quota-bot: Quota exception request Q-8421 received for org_acme_123. Reviewing...
quota-bot: Quota exception approved: +340 qps (total 400 qps) to hosted key scoped:poс_poc for org_acme_123. Window: 1915150000 -> 1915157200. Request ID: Q-8421. Approver: infra-ops.
Devin (SRE): Exception is applied and monitoring dashboard is live. I'll watch latency and error rates during the window and ping here if anything flares. @Maya please confirm you have the scoped key once Sam posts it.
Maya (AE): Received, will pass to customer and confirm rotation instructions. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Jordan (Sales Eng): Noted the billing cap and abort option. I'll update the POC playbook and customer-facing runbook.
Sam (Platform Eng): Scoped key created: will DM the key to Maya and also push the short runbook to the customer's contact. Leaving alerts to Devin.
Devin (SRE): Monitoring active. If any sustained p95 >150ms I will flip the fallback throttle and notify.
Maya (AE): Perfect — thanks everyone.
